message.content:
Build "Visitor Analytics + richer client info" for the Nxeon ADMIN portal. Work EXCLUSIVELY in the git worktree at /opt/nxeon-wt-analytics (branch feature/visitor-analytics). Do not touch /opt/nxeon or other worktrees. node_modules is symlinked there.

OWNER ASKS (two related cards):
- "sort visitor analytics by date; be able to hide certain IP traffic like my own IP to see actual public traffic."
- "more info on customers: signed-in IPs, when last logged in, visited pages, country/location."

RULES: Do NOT run any build/prisma command — write code only. Follow existing patterns: FIRST check whether the repo ALREADY tracks page views / visitor analytics (grep for 'analytics', 'PageView', 'visit', 'traffic' in app/admin, lib/, prisma/schema.prisma). Reuse what exists; don't duplicate. Match design system + RBAC (lib/rbac.ts).

BUILD (reuse existing tables where possible; only add schema if none exists):
1. Admin visitor-analytics view: sortable/filterable BY DATE (date range), with an IP-exclusion filter so the admin can hide specific IPs (e.g. their own) to see real public traffic. If the repo already records requests/logins/pageviews, aggregate from that; if not, add a minimal lightweight PageView model + a recording hook (middleware or a server-side logger) — keep it cheap (no PII beyond IP/path/timestamp/country) and additive.
2. Country/location: derive from IP (use a lightweight approach — if the repo already has a geo helper use it; otherwise store the raw IP and resolve country best-effort, or leave country as a nullable field populated when a resolver is available — do NOT add a paid API dependency).
3. Enrich the ADMIN CLIENT PROFILE (note: another change on a sibling branch also edits app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx — to avoid a hard conflict, prefer adding a SEPARATE small component/section or a new sub-area rather than heavily rewriting that page; if you must edit it, keep edits minimal and localized) with: last login time, recent signed-in IPs, and country — sourced from the login audit log / your analytics table. Only show fields that exist.

Keep it lightweight and privacy-respecting. DELIVER end-to-end, then in the worktree: `git add -A && git commit -m "feat: admin visitor analytics (date+IP filter) + client IP/geo/last-login"` (trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>), then `git push -u origin feature/visitor-analytics`. REPORT (factual): files changed, schema additions (if any), whether you reused an existing table or added one, how country is derived, and note if you edited app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx (and how minimally). Don't claim tested.

Done. Committed as `b0ce412` and pushed to `origin/feature/visitor-analytics`.

## What I found first (reused, not duplicated)
The worktree's base branch already shipped both owner cards' core work via prior commits:
- `600a2a5` — a full visitor-analytics dashboard at `/admin/visitors` with a `Visit` table, the "hide my own IP" exclude panel (`ExcludeIpPanel` + `lib/actions-analytics.ts` + `excludedIps`/`ipEx` in `lib/analytics.ts`), geo, globe, and a newest-first recent-visits feed.
- `27fca05` — the admin client-profile enrichment on `app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx` (sign-in IPs, last login, country/location, recent portal pages), sourced from `Visit.userId` + the `user.login` audit log.

So ask #2 (richer client info) and the IP-hiding half of ask #1 already existed. I reused all of it rather than rebuilding.

## What was genuinely missing — what I built
Ask #1's "sort visitor analytics **by date**" only existed as a fixed newest-first list; there was no explicit **date-range** filter. I added that additively:

- **`lib/analytics.ts`** — new `visitFeed()` and `visitFeedCount()` helpers with a `FeedFilter` (from/to `yyyy-mm-dd`, kind, sort direction), reusing the SAME `ipEx()` exclusion so hidden IPs stay hidden in the feed. Capped (default 100, hard max 500) to stay cheap.
- **`components/admin/TrafficFeedFilter.tsx`** (new client component) — from/to date pickers, source (all/marketing/portal), and newest/oldest sort; state lives in URL query params (shareable/bookmarkable), matching the existing `ExcludeIpPanel` style.
- **`components/admin/VisitorStats.tsx`** — new `TrafficFeedTable` with an **absolute** timestamp column (vs. the live table's "3h ago") plus a result count.
- **`app/admin/visitors/page.tsx`** — reads `searchParams`, renders the filter + feed as a new section below the existing dashboard (existing dashboard untouched).

## Report facts
- **Files changed:** `lib/analytics.ts`, `components/admin/VisitorStats.tsx`, `app/admin/visitors/page.tsx` (modified); `components/admin/TrafficFeedFilter.tsx` (new).
- **Schema additions:** none. Reused the existing `Visit` table (`ip/path/referrer/kind/userId/country/region/city/lat/lng/geocoded/createdAt`) and the `Setting`-backed exclude list.
- **Country/location:** derived by the existing `worker/geo.ts`, which resolves IP → country/region/city via the free, keyless ip-api.com endpoint, caches into `GeoCache`, and stamps `geocoded=true` on `Visit`. No paid API added.
- **RBAC:** unchanged — page still gated by `requireArea("analytics")`.
- **`app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx`:** NOT edited — the sibling-branch client-info work already covers ask #2, so I avoided the flagged conflict entirely.

Not tested (no build/prisma run, per instructions).
